questions.title: Kitchen and restaurant operations; Hygiene, safety and security

subQuestions.questionText:
Study the scenario 'HOME INDUSTRY LINKED TO OUTBREAK': Authorities are investigating a gastroenteritis outbreak linked to a home-based business. Customers and some employees reported a variety of symptoms after consuming chicken pies bought from this business. Authorities have reminded food handlers to follow good food and personal hygiene practices at all times.
List FOUR symptoms that the people could be experiencing.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 x 1 (4 marks):
- Diarrhoea / runny stomach / watery stools
- Vomiting
- Abdominal pain / stomach pain / tummy ache / cramps
- Nausea
- Headaches
- Fever
- Dehydration
- Weakness / fatigue
- Chills

subQuestions.questionText: Justify why the infected employees were sent home.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- The food handler/employee may have diarrhoea
- The food handler must be prevented from spreading the virus / it could be spread to the guest or other employees
- Food handler might contaminate the food while working in the kitchen / they might not wash their hands properly after visiting the toilet
- Employees may not feel well / in severe cases workers might be dehydrated / need to visit the doctor
- Cannot do their work properly due to symptoms / unproductive

subQuestions.questionText: Recommend other practices, besides personal hygiene, that should be applied to prevent the spread of gastroenteritis.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 (4 marks):
- Eliminate insects and rodents from the kitchen / keep the kitchen free from pests
- Use screens on windows to keep insects and birds out
- Food should be properly stored / cover all food during storage
- Do not leave food lying around
- Keep food below 5 C or above 60 C / out of the danger zone
- Avoid cross-contamination between raw and cooked foods / separate raw and cooked food / segregate working areas
- Do not store food on the floor
- Do not allow waste to accumulate / keep lids on waste bins closed
- Use different colour chopping boards
- Cook food properly / high temperature destroys bacteria / make sure chicken is cooked properly
- Use bottled / boiled water; wash vegetables/fruits in uncontaminated/treated water
- Clean / sanitise work surfaces and equipment regularly

subQuestions.questionText: Describe FOUR precautions that should be considered when making online purchases.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 (4 marks):
- Use a credit card with a small limit for online purchases
- Make use of secure connections - it will begin with 'https'
- Check for a padlock at the bottom/top of the screen
- Do business with a reputable organisation / reliable supplier / not a scam
- Check the reviews of the establishment
- Use recommended websites or ones with which you are familiar
- Use the most recent version of the web browser / set it to the highest security level
- Make use of computers with privacy filters
- Do not click on any hyperlink contained within a 'spam' e-mail
- Read the terms and conditions on the supplier's website
- Make sure you are on the correct website
- Don't save personal information / banking details
- Make sure it is the correct product / price / size

subQuestions.memoText:
(2 marks - must be in the correct order):

Process 2 - Dispersion

subQuestions.questionText: Classify the product being prepared in Step 4.
subQuestions.memoText:

- Stirred custard / egg custard / cold dessert

subQuestions.questionText: Incorrect methods were used in Step 4. Predict the possible outcomes of the product in Step 4.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- The custard will be curdled / split / uneven texture / not smooth
- If boiled for too long it might burn / burnt taste
- There will be formation of pieces in the liquid / syneresis / protein over-coagulates and separates from the liquid / watery with pieces in it

subQuestions.questionText: Suggest precautionary measures that must be followed when preparing the product in Step 4 to ensure that the product is successful.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- Avoid overheating the milk / milk should be scalded / don't boil the milk
- Warm milk must be added to the eggs and not eggs to the milk / milk should be tempered
- It should be stirred constantly
- Cook on low to medium heat / not too high heat
- Cook over a bain-marie / double boiler
- Custard should be cooked until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon / don't overcook

subQuestions.questionText: Identify the type of meringue prepared in Step 6.
subQuestions.memoText: French meringue (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Describe guidelines to follow during the preparation of the meringue.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- There should be no traces of egg yolk in the egg white as it will prevent the egg white from foaming properly
- Egg whites must be at room temperature to foam best
- All equipment should be free of fat/grease / clean and dry / wipe bowl with lemon
- Acids such as cream of tartar or lemon juice can be added to help stabilise the foam
- Use mixing bowls that do not retain grease (glass, porcelain, stainless steel or copper)
- Beat egg whites to soft peak stage, then gradually add sugar and beat until stiff peaks form
- Don't overbeat the meringue
- Use the correct ratio of ingredients (egg white to sugar)

subQuestions.questionText: The Davey Hotel has a variety of ice creams and granita on the menu. Differentiate between the two frozen desserts.
subQuestions.memoText:
2 x 2 (4 marks):
ICE CREAM:
- High fat content / 10% fat / dairy based / cream
- Creamy, smooth texture
- Mixture is constantly stirred/churned during freezing to break ice crystals and include air
GRANITA:
- No fat / dairy content, made from fruit juice / puree / wine / flavoured water
- Granular, crunchy texture
- Contains finely crushed ice crystals which are broken up with a fork

subQuestions.questionText: Evaluate the suitability of using spun sugar as a topping for the ice cream.
subQuestions.memoText:
1 mark for stance + any 2 (3 marks):
Not suitable as a topping:
- The sugar starts melting / disintegrates / absorbs moisture / becomes sticky (the moisture of the ice cream melts the sugar)
- It will negatively impact on the appearance of the ice cream
- It can make it too sweet
OR Suitable as a topping:
- It will improve the flavour because of the caramelised sugar / complements the ice cream flavour
- It looks good if served quickly / it is a pretty garnish
- Adds a different / crunchy texture

subQuestions.questionText: Study the table (a trainee chef compiled a menu based on products bought at a speciality food market specialising in plant-based products - menu: Butternut Soup with Cheese Rolls; Phyllo pastry baskets with grilled vegetables; Fried Soya Schnitzel with a Greek Salad; Peach Compote with toasted almonds; Tea and Coffee. Ingredients bought: Peaches, Soya Schnitzels, Butternut, Toasted almonds). Justify why the menu is written INCORRECTLY according to the rules of menu writing.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 5 (5 marks):
- The word 'menu' should be written in uppercase, not in small letters
- The word 'menu' should be in bold and not un-bolded
- A type of meal should be indicated on the menu (e.g. lunch/dinner)
- Every name of a dish should start with a capital letter (the entree course starts with small letters)
- There is no separation of courses / no space between courses / incorrect spacing
- No names for the courses are provided (e.g. starter, entree, dessert)
- There is no date indicated on the menu / a date must be written out in full
- Bread should not be written on the menu

- The younger the animal the more tender the meat / age determines the grade of meat
- Muscles that are not often used result in more tender meat / a tranquil environment produces good quality meat
- Treatment before slaughtering influences the quality / the animal was kept calm before slaughtering

subQuestions.questionText: Give guidelines that should have been followed to ensure a successful appearance and texture of the product in Picture B.

- The correct proportions/ratio of ingredients should be used

- Ensure the shape is round / use a round cutter
- Use a minimum amount of flour during rolling and folding
- It must be rested after each stage of rolling and folding
- Bake at the correct temperature of 220 C / not too high
- Oven must be pre-heated; place the oven rack in the correct level (middle)
- Don't over-bake / don't open the oven door during baking
- Glaze the bouchee before baking

subQuestions.questionText: Describe how canning is used to preserve the pears.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 (4 marks):
- High heat used during the canning process destroys micro-organisms and enzymes
- Canning stops food from deteriorating as it is not exposed to oxygen anymore
- The pears are sealed in sterilised airtight containers in a concentrated sugar syrup that prevents the growth of micro-organisms
- Air is excluded / no oxygen / sealed containers are airtight, so micro-organisms cannot multiply and recontamination is prevented

= R27,99 + R9,99 + R6,00 + R5,00
= R48,98 / R49,00

= R48,98 (R49,00) / 40% (0,40)

- Sprinkle / dust with cinnamon and sugar / roll in castor sugar while still hot

subQuestions.label: 4.5.4(a)
subQuestions.questionText: Justify why the following procedure is important when preparing choux pastry: (a) Do not boil water and shortening for too long.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- Too much water will evaporate resulting in too little steam / water is the only raising agent, so the final product is significantly reduced in volume / small cavity / heavy / dense product
- Fat will ooze out of the final product resulting in an oily product

subQuestions.label: 4.5.4(b)
subQuestions.questionText: Justify why the following procedure is important when preparing choux pastry: (b) Eggs should be added to the cooled paste a little at a time.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- If the paste is still hot the egg will over-coagulate / paste would be lumpy / the egg will curdle in the paste due to coagulation, resulting in a poor end product
- If all the eggs are added at once the final product may not rise enough to form a proper cavity
- Mixture won't emulsify properly / will be difficult to work with
- To get the correct consistency / make sure pastry is not too runny

subQuestions.label: 4.5.4(c)
subQuestions.questionText: Justify why the following procedure is important when preparing choux pastry: (c) Do not add more flour to the paste after the flour mixture has been cooked.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- Extra flour will cause the choux pastry to collapse
- No cavity will form / it will not rise properly
- Extra flour will not gelatinise / the flour will still be raw / floury taste
- It will alter the ratio of ingredients

questions.title: Sectors and careers; Food and beverage service

subQuestions.questionText:
Study the scenario: An international tour group visited the Mpumzale Restaurant. One of the guests, who had a couple of drinks too many, started to become loud and began bothering other guests. The waiter asked the guest politely to stop. When the guest demanded another drink, the waiter hesitated, but served the drink. The guest became so intoxicated that he started dancing on the table. He lost his balance, fell from the table and fractured his ankle.
Name the staff member that should have assisted the waiter.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 1 (1 mark):
- Security / bouncer
- Restaurant manager / manager
- Maitre d'hotel / head waiter

subQuestions.questionText: Argue whether the waiter handled the situation with the intoxicated guest correctly.
subQuestions.memoText:
1 mark for stance + any 3 (4 marks):
The waiter's reaction was good / yes:
- The waiter was calm
- He asked the guest politely to stop bothering the other guests
- To stop any aggravation, he complied and served the guest another drink
OR The waiter's reaction was not good / no:
- He should not have given the guest another drink as he was already intoxicated / according to law
- He should have offered him coffee instead
- He should not have allowed the guest to dance on the table / should have kept the incident quiet
- He should rather have asked the guest to leave the restaurant
- He should have sought help from security / manager to intervene

subQuestions.questionText: Apart from first aid, suggest how the restaurant staff should handle the unforeseen circumstance of the guest fracturing his ankle.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- Handle the situation according to the correct procedure/policy of the establishment
- The manager should handle this situation as it is a major injury
- Emergency services must be contacted; they will be responsible for the treatment / take the guest to a doctor or hospital
- Staff members should stay calm and be professional
- Keep the injured guest calm / comfortable
- Move the guest away from other guests / handle discreetly
- The incident should be reported / paperwork should be completed

subQuestions.questionText: Study the advert (Job Opportunity: Telesales executive for Mpumzale Guest House; Qualifications: Degree/Post graduate; 5 years' experience; energetic with positive attitude; selection criteria: face-to-face interview, critique online marketing tool, comprehensive CV; www.mpumzale.com; closing date 6 May 2022) and web page for Mpumzale Luxury Guest House. Name the department under which the telesales personnel fall.
subQuestions.memoText: Marketing / Sales and marketing (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: State the roles and responsibilities of a telesales person.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- To phone potential clients
- To promote/market/advertise the establishment / introduce products and services to clients / convince customers to purchase
- To send SMSs, multimedia messages and e-mails of specials
- To keep the website updated with specials/products/services / provide correct information / social networking
- To work closely with the marketing manager/team to create marketing material and ensure the establishment stands out
- Maintain a professional image for the establishment

subQuestions.questionText: Outline the role of the human resources manager after a suitable candidate has been appointed by the establishment.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- The HR manager must see that the suitable candidate is trained
- Induct the candidate to fit into the dynamics of the establishment / familiarise the new employee with the work environment
- An employment contract (including salary, leave, dispute procedures) must be drawn up and signed
- The code of professional conduct, procedures, work schedules and rosters must be explained
- Takes care of disciplinary actions/issues in the workplace
- Evaluation of performance in the workplace

subQuestions.questionText: Motivate why the webpage is a successful visual and electronic marketing tool for the guest house.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 5 (5 marks):
- This webpage is very informative
- All the information needed is available (location/vicinity/attractions, contact details, availability of accommodation)
- It is short and to the point / easy to follow
- Big lettering that is easy to read is used
- Interesting / relevant pictures and photos
- Simple language free from spelling mistakes is used
- The price of the product is stated
- Products offered are clearly outlined
- The layout is neat / organised / looks professional
- Outreach is greater / visible to a world-wide / large audience

subQuestions.label: 5.2.5(a)
subQuestions.questionText: (a) Define revenue generating areas.
subQuestions.memoText:
(1 mark):
- Revenue-generating areas are areas that earn an income for an establishment
- People pay for areas or services

subQuestions.label: 5.2.5(b)
subQuestions.questionText: (b) Identify TWO examples of revenue generating areas on the webpage.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- Guest rooms / accommodation
- Food and beverage / restaurant
- Spa

subQuestions.questionText: Name THREE marketing mix concepts that an entrepreneur must take into consideration when setting up a business.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- Price
- Place / business area / location
- Product
- Promotion / advertising
- People / customers / consumer / target market
- Packaging / display / presentation of product

subQuestions.questionText: Explain how the Covid-19 pandemic negatively impacted on the hospitality industry and the economy of the country.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 (4 marks):
- The gross domestic product (GDP) of the economy of South Africa decreased
- A decrease in hotel occupancy / decrease in eating at restaurants / less travelling and less use of hospitality establishments
- Many hospitality establishments closed down / shut down of restaurants and hotels
- Loss of jobs
- There was no demand for companies that supply products to the hotels
- Economic growth was not stimulated / local income decreased
- No income generated to contribute to the development and improvement of the country's infrastructure
- Multiplier effect decreased
- No tourists visiting hotels to contribute valuable foreign currency
- The esteem and living standards of the community could not improve

subQuestions.questionText: Comment on the overall appearance of the napkin.

subQuestions.questionText: A group of college students visited the Soweto Wine Festival. They have no previous knowledge of wine, how it is stored or the pairing of wine with food. Assist the students by providing the classification of wine that matches the descriptions below: A No additional ingredients have been added to the wine during fermentation; B Large carbon dioxide bubbles are formed in the bottle during fermentation; C Addition of wine spirits to stop fermentation.
subQuestions.memoText:
(3 marks):
A - Natural wine / still wine
B - Sparkling wine
C - Fortified wine

subQuestions.questionText: List THREE types of information that should be included on the front of a wine label.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 3 (3 marks):
- Name / type of wine / cultivar
- Class-designated wine
- Unique name
- Harvest year / vintage / date of production
- Origin of wine / region / country of origin
- Name of the business
- Producer / brand / estate / name of vineyard
- Alcohol content
- Bottle volume

subQuestions.questionText: Recommend how the food and beverage personnel should store corked red wine bottles.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 5 (5 marks). Corked red wine bottles should be stored:
- In a cellar/storage area that is clean and well ventilated
- In a slightly damp area / at a humidity level of 70% to prevent the cork from drying out
- In an area free from any vibration
- In the dark / away from direct sunlight and ultra-violet light / subdued lighting only
- At a constant cool temperature / between 10-16 C
- In a slightly raised position with the corks at the top / flat / horizontal position so the sediment remains at the bottom
- Upside down if in boxes
- With the label to the top or to the front
- With similar red wines together
- Rotate the wine bottles on a regular basis

subQuestions.questionText: Study the picture of the bread service below. Identify the serving style used to serve the bread.
subQuestions.memoText: Silver service (1 mark)

subQuestions.questionText: Describe how the waiter would conduct the technique in the restaurant.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 4 (4 marks):
- Bread service is from the left side of the guest
- The basket/tray/service plate must be on the left-hand palm of the waiter
- The waiter must lower their left hand (holding the basket) to no more than 5 cm from the edge of the guest's side plate
- The waiter must pick up the bread roll in the right hand using service utensils (service spoon and fork) and transfer it to the side plate
- In an anticlockwise direction, offering a bread roll to each guest
- Waiters must remember to serve ladies first
- Start with the guest on the right-hand side of the host and end with the host
- Waiters must not leave the basket on the table

subQuestions.questionText: Explain the procedure of correcting covers in a formal dinner.
subQuestions.memoText:
Any 2 (2 marks):
- Remove any unused covers / covers of guests who didn't arrive
- Covers must be corrected after orders have been taken, up until the main course
- Correct the knife part of the first guest and then the fork part of the next guest by standing between the two guests
- Place the required item in sequence of use (e.g. if a guest ordered fish for a main course, the table/joint knife and fork are replaced with a fish knife and fork)
- Replace cutlery that was incorrectly used by guests
- Remove glassware that the guest is not going to use (e.g. wine glasses if the guest is not drinking wine); take glasses by the stem and place them on a tray
